hypothesis.rationale: Hyperparameters are still being explored. Recent experiments show n_layer=6 achieved only 0.133 EM (iter 36) and 0.0056 EM (iter 37) with increased n_embd. Previous layer count changes have not been thoroughly explored at higher values.
hypothesis.instruction: Change n_layer from 6 to 12 in .autoresearch/experiment_config.yaml to increase model depth for better memory-augmented processing capacity.
